name: catalyst-ops
description: How Catalyst Shift operates. Three skills: ways-of-working (three homes — repos/Linear/SharePoint — and the build method: issue-as-spec, kanban, concept vs harden PRs, Red vs Normal, auto-land), verify (fresh-context verifier: diff + checklist only, PASS/FAIL with evidence, run before every /ship), and decision-governance (proposed-vs-decided labelling, no absent-party attribution, ratification rules). Behavior only; canon content stays in the strategy doc and docs/HOW_WE_BUILD.md.
